title: BT and Ericsson upgrade London network with AI software deployment
summary: BT completes the UK's first commercial deployment of Ericsson’s AI-native Scheduler for Link Adaptation, activating the software feature across its EE mobile network in London The feature has increased average download speeds by 26 percent and improved spectral efficiency by over 13 percent, helping BT make the most of its deployed spectrum The upgrade was completed remotely on existing AI-ready RAN Compute, delivering performance gains across London without any hardware changes or site visits
body_markdown:
- BT completes the UK's first commercial deployment of Ericsson’s AI-native Scheduler for Link Adaptation, activating the software feature across its EE mobile network in London
- The feature has increased average download speeds by 26 percent and improved spectral efficiency by over 13 percent, helping BT make the most of its deployed spectrum
- The upgrade was completed remotely on existing AI-ready RAN Compute, delivering performance gains across London without any hardware changes or site visits
